status: four independent visual cases passed after one preflight failure
scope: Independent non-timing Xvfb desktop demo on test-env, private network namespace, 2x scale, 1800 ms controlled startup delay. Not part of the ordinary paired timing comparison; no Kindle, live account, or optical measurements.
mode: Only the direct application child received BILICOMICS_DESKTOP_PRESENT_PROBE=wake. The successful run checked its executable identity and environment, its PID-owned X11 window, and the same process's UI-thread full-submit and post-submit events in each case.

measurements.early_feedback: Earliest exact X11 reads of the frozen startup title/loading label and initial activity rectangle. The two read-end offsets are milliseconds relative to the same process's workers_started observation; negative is before admission.
measurements.activity: Each reported state is an exact read of the complete X11 activity region matching the frozen four-segment arrangement with the specified segment active. Only reads wholly within the 1800 ms worker interval are included, with consecutive duplicate states removed.
measurements.x11_shelf: Differences count RGB pixels versus the frozen normal X11 Shelf on the first observation after Ready and three subsequent samples 1.50, 1.85 and 2.20 seconds after observing Ready. None is a first-presentation timestamp.

attempts.failure: The observer's immediate read of the direct application child's /proc/PID/environ did not observe the selected key. It terminated the child before any snapshot, lifecycle or performance file existed. The instant Xvfb shutdown check also saw a still-exiting process; the private PID namespace subsequently closed.
attempts.retry_change: The new private run checked the executable identity and waited up to one second for a readable environment on the same unreaped child; it refused an observable wrong mode. Xvfb retirement was checked for up to two seconds. No formal timing case was rerun or replaced.
